Package com.signalwire.sdk.runtime.lambda

Class LambdaResponse

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.runtime.lambda.LambdaResponse
public final class LambdaResponse extends Object
Response shape returned by LambdaAgentHandler and compatible with AWS API Gateway (REST v1 and HTTP v2) and Lambda Function URL response envelopes.

The fields map 1:1 to APIGatewayProxyResponseEvent: statusCode, headers, body, isBase64Encoded. Returned as a plain Map so the SDK does not require a runtime dependency on aws-lambda-java-events. Users who want the typed variant can trivially copy the fields over.

      Create a Lambda response with the given fields.
      Parameters:
      statusCode - HTTP status code.
      headers - response headers (must not be null — pass an empty map for no headers).
